description: This file defines an abstract class SynthVoice, which serves as a base class for polyphonic synthesizer voices in an Android MIDI synthesizer application. It manages note state, amplitude, and provides methods for playing notes, mixing audio output, and rendering sound.

classes.name: SynthVoice
classes.description: An abstract base class for a polyphonic synthesizer voice, managing note playback states, amplitude, and rendering audio output.

methods.name: noteOn
methods.description: Starts playing a note with a specified note index and velocity by changing the internal state and setting amplitude.

methods.name: noteOff
methods.description: Stops the currently playing note by updating the internal state.

methods.name: mix
methods.description: Adds the output of this voice to an output buffer, scaled by level, by repeatedly calling the render method for each frame.

methods.name: render
methods.description: An abstract method to generate the current sample. Must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: isDone
methods.description: Returns true if the voice has finished playing (state is off).

methods.name: getNoteIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the current note being played.

methods.name: getAmplitude
methods.description: Returns the current amplitude of the voice.

methods.name: setAmplitude
methods.description: Sets the amplitude of the voice.

methods.name: setFrequencyScaler
methods.description: Sets the frequency scaler for the voice (empty implementation in base class).
